tutorial.targets: In 3-2-5 **nobody bids**. The three seats are handed targets of **3, 2 and 5** tricks, and the roles rotate each round. **Making your number or more counts**; falling short does not.
tutorial.trump: Only the **5-target seat** names trump, and it can see **just five of its cards**. Choosing before the hand is complete is where the gamble lives.
tutorial.exchange: **Extra tricks score nothing.** Instead, your surplus lets you take that many of a short player's **best cards** next round, giving back your worst. That is the only reason to overshoot.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Playable cards get a green ring. Once you have made your target, play low and **stop taking tricks**.
